solve.reasoning: The body is pressed against a vertical wall with a normal force N = 100 N. The maximum static friction force is f_max = μ * N = 0.3 * 100 = 30 N. The gravitational force acting on the body is mg = 2 kg * 9.8 m/s² = 19.6 N. Since the gravitational force (19.6 N) is less than the maximum static friction (30 N), the body remains in equilibrium. In this state, the static frictional force exactly balances the weight of the body. Therefore, the frictional force is 19.6 N.
